subject.title: fix: preserve BOOTSTRAP.md in preseeded workspaces (#91931)

question: Should an existing `BOOTSTRAP.md` with no `setupCompletedAt` remain authoritative pending state even when profile files differ from their templates, accepting the reduced profile-only stale-bootstrap cleanup behavior?
rationale: The code intentionally changes a pre-existing reconciliation heuristic across upgrades; tests establish the new behavior but cannot decide whether that compatibility tradeoff is the permanent product contract.

options.title: Adopt and document the pending-state rule
options.body: Accept `BOOTSTRAP.md` plus missing `setupCompletedAt` as pending unless durable non-skill user content exists, and document the managed-workspace and stale-repair boundary before merge.

options.title: Preserve profile-only stale repair
options.body: Revise the implementation to distinguish managed preseeding from legacy orphan cleanup without making all profile-only pending workspaces remain pending.

options.title: Pause for workspace-owner direction
options.body: Hold the PR until an owner defines the long-term completion evidence contract for preseeded and legacy workspaces.

recommendation.title: Adopt and document the pending-state rule
recommendation.body: Accept `BOOTSTRAP.md` plus missing `setupCompletedAt` as pending unless durable non-skill user content exists, and document the managed-workspace and stale-repair boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete managed-workspace behavior and preseeded-skills scenario that the compatibility choice must preserve.
